buildflow.title: Turn on Firebase Storage
buildflow.detail: Needs the Blaze plan (a card), a budget alert, then Storage > Get started and deploy storage.rules. Until this is done every photo and file upload fails: posts, portfolio, job photos. Check that Google accepts your card; prepaid cards are sometimes refused. BuildFlow's own reminder is set for 31 Oct.

buildflow.title: Decide how contractors pay (Stripe is not available in Jamaica)
buildflow.detail: Billing is a stub: $50/month is displayed but nothing charges or enforces the trial. For the first 10 founding contractors use bank transfer or PayPal invoices and mark them paid in the admin screen. Then choose WiPay or PayPal subscriptions. Once you choose, I can build trial enforcement and a paid-until field.

buildflow.title: Add real company details and get the legal pages reviewed
buildflow.detail: Production refuses to start until support email, company name, address, governing law and NEXT_PUBLIC_LEGAL_REVIEWED=true are set. The Privacy Policy and Terms still contain placeholders. I can draft wording; a lawyer must review it.

buildflow.title: Move BuildFlow's Vercel project to Pro before charging
buildflow.detail: Hobby is non-commercial. Set the production environment variables at the same time (Firebase values, service account key as a secret, legal and support variables).
buildflow.src: Integration test report, P2-5; Firebase checklist

buildflow.title: Choose the production Firebase project and deploy it properly
buildflow.detail: Decide build-6fa95 or buildflow-prod. Enable Email/Password, add the Vercel domain to authorised domains, set the email sender name, deploy rules, indexes and storage, turn on daily backups. Seed reference data on any new project before anyone signs up.

buildflow.title: Add push notifications for new leads
buildflow.detail: Without them a contractor never hears about a lead unless the app is open, the main reason a tester would stop using it. You register the Android app in Firebase; I add google-services.json and the push plugin.

buildflow.title: Run the Android app on a real phone
buildflow.detail: Check the photo picker, PDFs, back button, offline launch and Android 15 layout. The app has never run on a device.

buildflow.title: Create the Android upload keystore and back it up
buildflow.detail: Keep it outside git. Losing it means you cannot update the app. Set CAP_SERVER_URL to the production address.

buildflow.title: Prepare the Google Play listing
buildflow.detail: 512px icon, 1024x500 feature graphic, at least 2 phone screenshots, short and full descriptions, category, content rating, Data safety form, reviewer test account. I can draft the texts. Check Play Console for the current closed-testing tester requirement for new accounts.

buildflow.title: Sign 10 founding contractors (your strongest skill)
buildflow.detail: Free for 60 days in exchange for feedback, a set of job photos and a testimonial. Pitch: your leads are yours, one flat monthly price, WhatsApp-first. Share each contractor's profile link or QR with their own customers, since a directory has no value without both sides.

buildflow.title: Test the price with real contractors
buildflow.detail: $50/month including 1 user, +$20 per extra user, is a bet and has not been validated. Ask each founding contractor: would you pay this, in USD or JMD, and is a cheaper solo tier needed?

buildflow.title: Study ClickAway, the Jamaican competitor
buildflow.detail: A local matching app with job bidding and payments, reported at about 2,800 beta users. BuildFlow's angle: leads are yours, flat price, built for the field.

buildflow.title: Decide on messaging
buildflow.detail: Private client link or in-app chat. Today customers contact contractors by quote request, phone or WhatsApp.

buildflow.title: Hardening: error monitoring, photo thumbnails, Content-Security-Policy
buildflow.detail: Agent work once the P0 items are clear: Sentry-style monitoring, thumbnails once Storage is on, and a CSP header.
buildflow.src: Integration test report, P2-2 to P2-4

system.title: Connect Twilio WhatsApp alerts
system.detail: Create the account, join the sandbox, add TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN, TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM and WHATSAPP_TO in Vercel.

system.title: Add the Anthropic key and token prices
system.detail: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (Secret) plus LLM_PRICE_IN_PER_MTOK and LLM_PRICE_OUT_PER_MTOK from the pricing page. The $80 cap is already set.

system.title: Upgrade this project's Vercel team to Pro before real revenue
system.detail: Hobby is non-commercial. Also unlocks longer functions and more frequent cron.

system.title: Turn off Vercel Deployment Protection for production
system.detail: Needed so the phone app can load the manifest. The owner login protects the data.

system.title: Create a Solana address only if you go after Superteam bounties
system.detail: They pay in USDC/USDG on Solana; Treasury watches EVM chains only.

sources_setup.title: Add a GitHub token (read-only, no scopes)
sources_setup.detail: Raises Scout's GitHub search rate limit so it can look further before giving up. Create one at GitHub > Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens (classic, no scopes needed, read-only is fine). Add GITHUB_TOKEN as a Secret in Vercel.

sources_setup.title: Create an Upwork profile
sources_setup.detail: The largest general freelance market; $500+ fixed-price web/app work is common. Its job feed closed its public API in 2024, so this needs a manual profile and proposals - I can draft proposal text once you're set up.

sources_setup.title: Create a Contra profile
sources_setup.detail: No-fee, portfolio-first marketplace. A good fit for showing your BuildFlow and funnel work directly.

sources_setup.title: Apply to Braintrust
sources_setup.detail: Vetted talent network; the client pays the platform fee, so you keep more of the rate.

sources_setup.title: Apply as a Webflow/Framer Expert or Partner
sources_setup.detail: Matches your website/funnel-building skill directly; these directories route client work to listed experts.

sources_setup.title: Optional: create a Freelancer.com account
sources_setup.detail: Scout already reads Freelancer.com's public listings with no login. An account is only needed to actually bid - not required for discovery.

sources_setup.title: Optional: apply to Toptal, Gun.io or Arc.dev
sources_setup.detail: Vetted developer networks with larger projects; screening is extensive, worth it only once you want bigger, steadier work.
